name: demo-lead-qualifier
description: Expose the 3 agentic actions (capture_lead / qualify / book) of the deterministic lead FSM as MCP stdio tools. Each tool maps args → AgentAction → reduce() (src/lib/state.ts); the reducer validates every transition, so the AI cannot break the logic.

tools.name: capture_lead
tools.description: Create a new lead (status=new) and start the speed-to-lead timer. new→ valid from any state.

tools.name: qualify
tools.description: Transition new → qualified with score (0-100) + non-empty reason. Marks first response to measure speed-to-lead <60s.

tools.name: book
tools.description: Transition qualified → booked; bookingUrl defaults to the central Calendly URL (never mailto).
